data.narrative:
Harmattan AI is a Series B-stage defense and security company currently valued at $1.4B post-money following $200M in total fundraising. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—all operating in the Defense & Security sector at equivalent or proximate stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $1.4B last post-money valuation and applying a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, yields an implied valuation of $2.7B. Peer-median analysis across 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables—Dream Security ($3.0B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), Heven AeroTech ($1.0B), and one additional peer—produces a median of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $3.1B, with a median of $1.8B. The current $1.4B valuation sits in the lower-middle portion of this range, approximately 23% below the derived median. Key uncertainties include relative differentiation within a dispersed peer set (peer range exceeds 10x) and the applicability of stage-progression mechanics to frontier-tech defense applications, where growth trajectories may diverge materially from sector norms.
